coding.note: Contribution coding is limited to the abstract/introduction: model-family and checkpoint release are consolidated, with benchmark performance and comprehensive safety evaluation recorded separately. Architectural elements are explicitly prior techniques, not claimed innovations. The novel RL algorithm is mentioned only in the body, outside C1 scope. Training seeds are not reported; human-evaluation confidence intervals are not across training runs. Data categories are given without reconstructable sources/proportions. TPU counts and carbon emissions do not disclose compute in the required units or hardware × duration. Comparator results mix author-run evaluations with previously reported and external scores.

claims.quote:
This work introduces Gemma, a family of lightweight, state-of-the art open models built from the research
  and technology used to create Gemini models.
claims.claim: Introduces and releases Gemma, an open lightweight language-model family with 2B and 7B pretrained and fine-tuned checkpoints.

claims.quote:
Gemma
  outperforms similarly sized open models on 11 out of 18 text-based tasks
claims.claim: Gemma advances comparable-scale open-model performance, outperforming similarly sized models on 11 of 18 text tasks.

claims.quote:
we present comprehensive
  evaluations of safety and responsibility aspects of the models, alongside a detailed description of model
  development.
claims.claim: Provides comprehensive safety and responsibility evaluations and a detailed account of model development.

data_disclosure.quote:
